title: Unit Review: Prepositional Phrases and Quiroga
goal: Review the prepositional phrases and the verbs with fixed prepositions through a retelling of the start of Quiroga's Anaconda.
grammar: review of the prepositional phrases and verbs with fixed prepositions, and a retelling of Quiroga's Anaconda

items: I can read a short retelling of the start of Horacio Quiroga's Anaconda.
I can choose the phrase that fits the kind of cause, aim or source.
I can choose the right preposition for a verb such as *derivar en* or *abogar por*.
